regulator.name: College of Registered Nurses of Alberta

pathways.name: Already passed the NCLEX-RN
pathways.summary: Provide an NNAS advisory report or an education credential assessment from an approved service. A permit is issued if every registration requirement is met.

pathways.name: Equivalent education or credential recognition
pathways.summary: An NNAS advisory report or an approved education credential assessment allows the applicant to request to write the NCLEX-RN.

requirements.title: Pathways to a Permit tool
requirements.description: Must be completed before creating a College Connect account; it recommends an application pathway.

requirements.title: Credential assessment
requirements.description: An NNAS advisory report or an education credential assessment from an approved service.

requirements.title: NCLEX-RN
requirements.description: All pathways require passing the NCLEX-RN.

requirements.title: Post-secondary education requirement
requirements.description: Evidence varies by application type and is needed only for the first application.

requirements.title: Currency of practice
requirements.description: Recent nursing practice or education. Practice years run Oct. 1 to Sept. 30. LPN hours, the NCLEX-RN and the discontinued Supervised Practice Program do not count.

any_of.program: Registered Nurses Canadian Competence Assessment Program (RN-level result)
Approved re-entry to nursing practice program

requirements.title: English language proficiency
requirements.description: A test taken within the last two years, or an exemption. No other tests are accepted, and the NCLEX-RN does not count.

exemptions: A nursing program of at least two years of full-time study in Canada, with theory and clinical taught in English (any time).
A nursing program of at least two years of full-time study outside Canada, with theory and clinical taught in English (within the last five years).
At least 250 hours of nursing practice where health care is provided in English (within the last five years).

requirements.title: Criminal record check
requirements.description: Completed online. Non-residents of Canada use an alternate method.

requirements.title: Good character and reputation
requirements.description: Answer the character questions in the application.

requirements.title: Fitness to practise
requirements.description: Answer the fitness-to-practise questions in the application.

requirements.title: Protecting Patients from Sexual Abuse and Misconduct course
Professional liability protection
requirements.description: Professional Liability Protection and Core Services from the Canadian Nurses Protective Society (CNPS), paid separately from CRNA fees.

requirements.title: Government-issued identification
requirements.description: Used to validate identity when creating the College Connect account.

documents.name: NNAS advisory report or approved education credential assessment
documents.description: If NNAS has already been started, its report contains all the evidence needed; leaving NNAS usually means paying separately for evidence.

documents.name: NCLEX-RN result
documents.description: For applicants who have already passed it.

timelines.name: CRNA review after competency information is received
Permit validity
timelines.description: Practice year from Oct. 1 to Sept. 30; a discounted permit is available for permits from May 1 to Sept. 30.

open_questions: Fees are the 2025-2026 amounts. The 2026-2027 schedule (published June 19, 2026) has not been captured yet.
The approved credential assessment services other than NNAS are not listed on the pages captured.
Course-level matching (Phase 2) needs the entry-level RN competencies, which have not been captured yet.
